changelog:
Initial release of Polymarket 5m Trading skill.

- Finds high-volume, BTC-related Polymarket markets priced between 40% and 60% YES.
- Buys 1 USD of YES, holds for 5 minutes, then sells; repeats for 10 buy/sell cycles.
- Supports dry-run by default; live mode requires private key and confirmation via `--live`.
- Allows customization of trade size, hold time, and other parameters.
- Includes logic for market discovery, order creation, market checks, and graceful exits if conditions aren't met.
